method.fresh: empty Catalog, OS filesystem cache left intact
method.timingBlocks: serial without compilation/tests; small and medium before/after 3 samples each, large before 3 then after 6 then before confirmation 3; one warmup per state in each block
method.adapter: same built TypeScript adapter and workloads for both native executables
method.queries: all five paged candidate routes after warm refresh
method.inputDecode: targeted Enhanced Input step from fresh runs; unchanged parser and decode implementation
method.memory: median and maximum sampled process working sets, not allocator accounting; missing brief native samples remain null
method.profiles: isolated instrumented readers; worker elapsed totals overlap; retained profile precedes the equivalent Clippy iterator cleanup in the coordinator loop
